title: Step composition — exclusive seconds per phase
description: Seconds each phase spent outside its own children, so the bands sum to the step at any depth. `generate` near zero is correct — it is pure orchestration. A negative band means a child is being counted inside its parent.

defaults.noValue: No inclusive-wall driver rows under root='step'. This build publishes no step timings.

params.value: WITH driver AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') AS phase, json_get(attributes_json, 'parent') AS parent, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'trainer' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') = 'inclusive_wall' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'root') = 'step' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), contained AS ( SELECT bucket, s, parent AS phase, SUM(value) AS child_seconds FROM driver WHERE parent IS NOT NULL AND parent <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), banded AS ( SELECT driver.bucket AS bucket, CASE WHEN driver.phase = 'step' THEN 'unattributed' ELSE driver.phase END AS band, driver.value - COALESCE(contained.child_seconds, 0) AS seconds FROM driver LEFT JOIN contained ON contained.bucket = driver.bucket AND contained.s = driver.s AND contained.phase = driver.phase ) SELECT bucket AS t, band AS series, AVG(seconds) AS value FROM banded GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
